pages.title: A thick pizza · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy evening in downtown Chicago. Lu and her brother walk fast with their coats closed. They see a warm, yellow window with a pizza sign. Inside, the room smells like cheese and tomato. A waiter named Vic leads them to a table. He brings two menus and a smile.
“Welcome to Windy Pizza! Table for two?” says Vic. “Yes, please. We want a deep dish pizza.” says Lu. “Great choice. Small, medium or large?” says Vic.
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: A thick pizza · 3/3
paragraphs: “Two lemonades, please.” says Lu. “Okay. I will bring them right away.” says Vic. Vic brings two cold lemonades and a basket of bread. Lu and her brother talk while they wait. After forty minutes, the pizza arrives hot. It is thick and full of cheese. They eat slowly and share every slice. A slow meal is a warm gift on a cold night.
